six_lenses.details: test_suite.json declares 56 TCs in coverage_map. Backend: 43 S2 + 46 S1 regression + 12 system fixtures = 101 critical/high tests all PASS. Frontend: 5/13 PASS + 6 zod-direct passing as added. Every UI-related AC has at least 1 backend test verifying the same invariant. No critical AC lacks coverage. TC-087 concurrency simplified to compile-check at unit level but functionally verified by ST-007 (2-session real-PG test).

findings.summary: 7 frontend tests (TC-092/093/095/097/099/101/102) deferred to TD-010 due to Radix UI Select + Popover incompatibility with jsdom. Backend API tests cover the same ACs via integration tests (IS-005/006/007 + service-level TCs).

six_lenses.details: 4/4 IS scenarios pass on first execution: IS-005 inward→ledger, IS-006 sales decrement, IS-007 adjustment full DF-003 flow (incl zero-diff audit), IS-008 back-date forward-recompute. Module contract chain M-002 services → M-007 repositories/models → M-003 domain verified end-to-end. No module boundary violations observed.

4/4 ST scenarios pass. Performance ST-004 met with 23× headroom (p95=4.4ms vs 100ms budget) leaving ample latency for S3 read-path. ST-005 boundary parametrized verified AC-021 exact 7-day window. ST-006 security verified Pydantic+DB CHECK defense-in-depth. ST-007 (TC-087 functional concurrency) discovered TD-011 (PG SELECT FOR UPDATE LIMIT 1 race) and fixed in-step with pg_advisory_xact_lock — iteration 2 PASS.

findings.summary: TD-011 closed at code level (advisory lock added to domain.stock._apply) but DS-002 spec text in .ases/decisions.json still describes the lock pattern as 'SELECT FOR UPDATE on the latest ledger row' without mentioning the advisory-lock-first requirement. Spec text amendment recommended for S3 to prevent future regressions.

six_lenses.details: 21/21 ACs accepted. 0 accepted_with_notes (no conditional findings). 0 rejected. 5 cross-cutting verifications (DS-002/003/004/013 + write-path perf) also accepted. No UAT findings to convert to tech debt — the only UAT-noted items (TD-010, TD-011, TD-008) were already logged during prior ship steps.

16 backend tasks all CLEAN on iteration 1, meaning critique verified every method signature against LLD. LLD files[0..15] interfaces all implemented correctly. New decisions (DS-013 + DS-014) properly added to .ases/decisions.json with full rationale + tradeoffs. TD-011 surfaced an implicit DS-002 weakness (covered by FA-S2-002 above).

findings.summary: DS-002 spec text in decisions.json describes only 'SELECT FOR UPDATE on latest ledger row' but the verified safe implementation also requires pg_advisory_xact_lock to handle PG's LIMIT-1 race documented behavior. Suggest updating DS-002 text in S3 design phase to mandate the layered pattern.

six_lenses.details: HLD critical/medium risks for S2: R-001 (concurrent-entry race) — mitigation verified end-to-end via ST-007 2-session test after TD-011 fix; R-003 (back-dated transactions) — verified via IS-008 + TC-086 (forward-recompute correctness). R-002 (oversell) is V1 documented-acceptable per LLD note (no AC). No new risks surfaced during ship.
